adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in both `next` and `previous` actions, `group.set('offset', offset)` is called before `group.findMembers()`. Looking at the diff, if `findMembers()` fails (returns a rejected promise), the offset has already been updated on the model, but the members array would still contain the old data. This creates an inconsistent state where the UI shows old members but the pagination state reflects the new (failed) page. The code does `group.set('offset', offset)` then `return group.findMembers()` without any error handling to revert the offset on failure.
